purpose: This table provides cleaned, hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, and visibility) for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, feeding downstream flight-delay and weather-correlation analyses.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to correlate weather conditions with flight events at the same airport and hour; consumers should expect and handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (nearly 75% null) rather than assuming a reading is always present.
limitations: wind_gust is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure is moderately sparse (null_rate 0.114953); these were retained as nullable rather than imputed, so aggregate statistics over these columns will reflect a reduced sample. All timestamps originate from a single source year (2013) and the dataset covers only three airports, so it cannot be used for broader geographic or multi-year weather analysis without additional data.
